title: 第25章 圣光背叛了我第26章 战利品瓜分
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: 再往上，是一双修长的腿，紫色的肌肤泛着幽光，隐没在无尽的黑暗中。
迷迷蒙蒙中，艾伦的视线一片模糊，看不见她的上半身。
“亲爱的，你又要死了。”
那声音特别温柔，宛如相识已久的老情人，深情地向他倾诉，
“你真是个负心的薄幸人呢。”
那声音继续说着，带着一丝幽怨，“明明是暗影的宠儿，简直是为虚空而生——你听不见吗？你周围的暗影，可是一直在躁动地渴求着你的临幸呢。”
她的脚轻轻在他胸口碾动。
“它们呼唤你，拥抱你，想要与你融为一体——可你却视而不见，把它们晾在一旁，跑去摆弄那些可笑的圣光和奥术。”
一声轻笑。
“多可惜呀。如果你愿意......”
她顿了顿，语气变得更加魅惑：
“永生永世做我的奴隶，为我奉献出你的一切。我保证，你会得到比圣光和奥术强大千百倍的力量。怎么样，我可爱的男孩？”
艾伦释怀地笑了。
果然是你啊，萨拉塔斯。
虽然早有猜测，但他不敢百分之百肯定，毕竟事关上古之神，怎么小心都不为过。
现在，确认向他低语的人就是萨拉塔斯的话，说不定真的可以……
借用她的力量，虽然也有风险，但萨拉塔斯对宿主不算太差，至少不会轻易变成一团古神造物。
而且，瓦里安、温雷、斯黛拉、摩根……他们都是因为他才来到这里的，都是因为他才陷入危险。
必须拯救他们。
还有……米拉娜。
我一定要亲手为她报仇。
艾伦深吸一口气，用尽全力开口：
“我以艾伦·普瑞斯托的名义向你起誓，我的女士，我愿意将艾伦·普瑞斯托的一切都奉献给你，请你给我力量。”
【欺瞒检定：失败】
那只玉足猛地抬起，然后用力踩在他脸上。
“我可爱的男孩——”
她的脚慢慢从他脸上划过，从鼻梁到嘴唇，从嘴唇到下巴，那触感冰凉而柔软。
“负心人。从你来到这里的那一刻，我就在含情脉脉地注视着你了。我知道......”
她的声音低了下去，带着一丝玩味：
“这不是你真正的姓名。”
“应该怎么发音呢？”她的脚停在他的下巴上，轻轻抬起他的脸，“艾岚？”
那两个字从她唇间吐出，十分准确。
“我可不喜欢被欺骗。”她说，语气里带着撒娇般的嗔怪，“用你真正的名字，向你的主人起誓。”
艾伦无奈地笑了。
“好吧。”
content_en:
;;
Further up, there is a pair of slender legs, with purple skin glowing, hidden in the endless darkness.
In the haze, Allen's vision was blurred and he couldn't see her upper body.
"Honey, you're dying again."
The voice was particularly gentle, like an old lover whom he had known for a long time, confiding to him affectionately,
"You are such a heartless and unlucky person."
The voice continued, with a hint of resentment, "You are obviously the darling of the shadows, but they are simply born for the void - can't you hear it? The shadows around you have been restlessly longing for your blessing."
Her feet lightly rubbed against his chest.
"They call you, embrace you, and want to become one with you - but you turn a blind eye, put them aside, and run away to play with those ridiculous holy lights and arcana."
A chuckle.
"What a shame. If you would..."
She paused and her tone became more seductive:
"Be my slave forever and ever, and dedicate everything you have to me. I guarantee that you will get a power a thousand times more powerful than the holy light and arcana. How about it, my lovely boy?"
Allen smiled in relief.
It is indeed you, Xal'atath.
Although he had already speculated, he could not be 100% sure. After all, when it came to the ancient gods, one could never be too careful.
Now, if he confirms that the person who whispered to him is Xal'atath, maybe it really can...
Although there are risks in borrowing her power, Xal'atath is not too bad for the host, at least he will not easily turn into a ball of creations of the ancient gods.
Moreover, Varian, Wen Lei, Stella, Morgan... they all came here because of him, and they were all in danger because of him.
They must be saved.
And...Milana.
I must avenge her with my own hands.
Allen took a deep breath and spoke with all his strength:
"I swear to you in the name of Ellen Presto, my lady, I am willing to dedicate everything of Ellen Presto to you, please give me strength."
[Deception check: failed]
The jade foot suddenly lifted up and then stepped hard on his face.
"My sweet boy—"
Her feet slowly moved across his face, from the bridge of his nose to his lips, and from his lips to his chin. The touch was cold and soft.
"Heartless person. From the moment you came here, I have been watching you lovingly. I know..."
Her voice lowered with a hint of amusement:
"That's not your real name."
"How should you pronounce it?" Her foot stopped on his chin and gently raised his face, "Ai Lan?"
Those two words came out from her lips with great accuracy.
"I don't like to be deceived." She said, with a coquettish tone in her voice, "Swear to your master by your real name."
Allen smiled helplessly.
"All right."
